diagnosis.reasoning: Queue depth and queue-time exploded while everything inside the engine got lighter: running requests, iteration tokens, generation token rate and KV usage all fell ~85%, and prefill cost, prefix hit rate, ITL and preemption are unchanged. So requests are piling up before/outside the scheduler rather than being crowded out by memory pressure or expensive prefills, and arrival rate actually dropped, ruling out capacity. That signature — admission starvation with an idle GPU-side batch and inflated queue wait — points to host-side saturation (CPU/API-loop stall) as the root cause, with queueing and the shrunken batch as its downstream effects.
